correctness.rationale: The exact twelve-edge definition yields 1698 faces by independent degree and forbidden-triple constructions. The full list of 847 matched pairs and 7980 Hasse incidences is checked by the standalone verifier; a complete topological sort demonstrates acyclicity, leaving precisely one zero-cell and three five-cells. The resulting finite Morse CW complex is a wedge of three five-spheres, not a Betti-number extrapolation. Signed chain traces for all 48 automorphisms are explicitly computed and agree under two independent group descriptions with the stated irreducible character.

value.rationale: The three-dimensional cube is the first nontrivial cubic hypercube and a canonical crown graph; capacity-two edge complexes are natural because their equivalent three-clique-free cuboctahedral model is central to recent topology. The computed complex has facets up to dimension seven but collapses to three five-spheres. Its full symmetry homology module is irreducible and bipartition-odd, extra structural content not recoverable from Betti numbers, the ordinary cube matching complex or a full complete-bipartite model.
